title: AM Import/Senior Import Executive
jobDescription:
Summary: In this role, comprehensive understanding of the Import supply chain process, from documentation and clearance to logistics and compliance, will be instrumental. Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
▪ Managing the import documentation process and overseeing Customs Clearance. ▪ Handling export documentation, Customs Clearance, Pre-shipment, and post-shipment activities. ▪ Conducting freight negotiations with Freight Forwarders and managing local transportation logistics. ▪ Verifying and approving vendor bills in accordance with established protocols. ▪ Demonstrating proficiency in dealing with Allied Agencies such as NOC, FSSAI, CDSCO, AQ, PQ, and DYCC. ▪ Expertise in Customs Clearance procedures for HSS, FTWZ, and Bond-to-Bond shipments. ▪ Managing and documenting Merchant Sales Transactions. ▪ Generating local and import purchase orders and transmitting them to suppliers. ▪ Coordinating with various stakeholders, including Suppliers, CHA, FF, Shipping Line Customer Service, Sales Support, Finance team, and regulatory bodies to ensure timely import customs clearance. ▪ Ensuring customs compliance and overseeing customs clearing costs and payments. ▪ Facilitating the movement of materials into the warehouse post-EVA approval, and ensuring accurate SAP entries and documentation according to standard operating procedures. ▪ Taking charge of overall supply chain management for LCL, FCL, and Bulk shipments. ▪ Providing essential inputs for new product creation, including determining HSN codes, custom duty assessments, and necessary licenses required in India. Any Graduate with minimum 4+ Years of relevant experience. title: Key Accounts Manager
jobDescription:
Job Summary: Role Summary: The ideal candidate will have a strong educational background in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering, coupled with 5–7 years of proven experience in Sales or Key Account Management within the manufacturing or chemical distribution sectors. Duties and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Set and execute regional strategies and targets for growth with P&L responsibility to achieve defined key account sales, volume and gross profit targets for the assigned Global and Regional Key Accounts Investigate for further / new opportunities and potentials for Global and Regional Key Account in line with company’s directives and levers (e.g. cross selling) in India. Develop and maintain Global and Regional Key Account knowledge (e.g Strategy, general needs, market) in India. Coordinate developments of Global and Regional Key Accounts’ site and regional buyers in India Work in close association with both divisions, business units and Regional Key Account Managers to identify and implement customer focused initiatives that expand Brenntag product offerings, strengthen loyalty, increase satisfaction and differentiate Brenntag as the distributor partner of choice. Build strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions by working closely with key principle contacts at all levels of the customer organization in India. Manage and ensure timely response to Regional Key Account Managers, Global and Regional Key Accounts’ inquiries and initiatives originated. Expand Brenntag relationships with key global and regional suppliers to create new product offerings, improve competitive position, reduce total cost of ownership and enhance overall profitability of the account. Take on additional roles related to the Key Account Management role defined and agreed by the Regional Key Account Team Manage consolidation program, enquiry, RFQ and any GKA projects initiated regionally or globally. Complete relevant periodic reports and admin tasks timely Job Requirement/Specification:
-

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s Degree in business, Science or related field Experience: Minimum 10 years of Sales & Marketing experience Location: Mumbai, India Others: As follows. Strong learning agility with the ability to make sound and independent decisions by relying on a mixture of analysis, wisdom, experience, and judgment when making decisions even in the absence of complete information. Highly self-motivation and driven. Able to communicate and work effectively with all levels of employees within Brenntag and customer organizations in India Has a strong bottom-line orientation and is persistent in in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks. Strong business acumen and customer orientation. Good analytical skills with a sound understanding on financial statement. High confident and strong interpersonal skills with good influencing skills Highly comfortable in anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders Strong customer orientation and market know-how Good time and project management skills Good team player working across different business units and divisions Strong and fluent in English (verbal and written) Strong Excel, Words and Power Point and various platform (SAP, Sales Force) Ability to travel within India as required to achieve business objectives Brenntag provides equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees of all backgrounds and identities to create a workplace where difference is valued because it forms a resilient and more innovative organization. title: Senior Executive, Warehousing & Transportation
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Plan and schedule daily transportation activities and delivery routes. Coordinate vehicle allocation based on shipment priorities and capacity. Monitor dispatch operations and ensure on-time deliveries. Optimize transportation costs, route efficiency, and fleet utilization. Liaise with transport vendors, drivers, warehouses, and internal teams. Track shipments and resolve transportation-related issues promptly. Maintain transportation records, MIS reports, and logistics documentation. Ensure compliance with safety regulations, transportation laws, and company policies. Analyze logistics performance metrics and suggest process improvements. Handle emergency transportation adjustments and escalation management. Plan in- or/and outbound transport taking into account transport regulation; Combine orders to achieve efficient transportation. Manage unforeseen incidents in the transportation planning process. Other Tasks Route optimization Vendor performance tracking Transportation MIS dashboard Fleet utilization Delivery turnaround time reduction initiative. GPS tracking and shipment visibility Cost-saving analysis for transportation operations. Process standardization for dispatch and documentation workflows. Working Conditions Flexible working hours based on operational requirements. Saturday working applicable. Ability to coordinate during peak shipment periods and urgent dispatch requirements. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple shipments simultaneously. title: Senior Sales manager - Agro Chemicals
jobDescription:
Job Summary: Brenntag is looking for a Sales Leader to drive EUR 2 million in annual revenue while leading a team of 2–3 sales professionals. The role will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of Specialty Chemicals (Additives, Defoamers, Feed Ingredients) and Solvents (Toluene, Cyclo, Mixed Xylene, Glycols, and related products) serving customers within the Agrochemical industry. Job Requirements/Specification:
-

EDUCATION:
Bachelors in Chemistry / Chemical Engineering, preferably MBA Experience: Minimum 13 years of overall work sales experience, including a minimum of 3-year experience of team management and 8 years managing Agrochemical industry Duties and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Group P&L Target: Deliver on budget P&L numbers by ensuring business execution of specific product & services sales, including developing new business and maintaining a healthy business pipeline. Lead a team of Account Managers to deliver on budget P&L (Volume & GP), by effective team management, market development and new business acquisition Build a 3 ~ 5 years strategy for Agro and include participation in various segments of Agro. Managing current suppliers and ensuring to get more suppliers complementing current offerings Stakeholder Management: Maintain working & efficient relationship with functional stakeholders within India such as Product Management, Customer Service, Supply Chain etc. This includes driving clarity on tasks scope and joint delivery of business. Customer outreach: Maintain adequate customer intimacy with regular visits, market feedback collection and analysis of information. Ensure safety and compliance, in line with all application Brenntag Policies, in daily working of business Participation in various exhibitions (ACREX, PMFAI), and conducting road shows across multiple cities Other Capabilities, Skills and Experience: Complete awareness of sales cycle (including processes, documentations etc.) for distribution business in India.
